definition_zh: 凝结；冷凝；缩合；浓缩；凝练；摘要
definition_en: the change of a vapour into a liquid, the drops so formed, or the act of making something denser or shorter
core_image: 冷玻璃杯壁上慢慢爬满细小的水珠，杯外的空气一直往杯壁靠拢
scene: 夏天的冰水杯放在桌上，杯壁很快蒙上一层细密水珠。Condensation covered the outside of the glass within a minute.
sceneCN: 这里指「空气中的水汽遇冷变成液态水的过程」（第 1 个义项：气态水转变为液态水的过程）；句意为一分钟之内凝结的水便盖满了玻璃杯外壁。图中可辨识物件：冰水杯、杯壁水珠、桌面水痕、窗上水汽。

pos.zh: 凝结；冷凝；缩合；浓缩；凝练；摘要

senses.title: Vapour turning into liquid
senses.titleCN: 水汽变为液态水的过程
senses.definition: the process in which a gas or vapour changes into a liquid as it cools
senses.definitionCN: 气体或蒸汽遇冷转变为液体的过程
senses.example: Condensation covered the outside of the glass within a minute.
senses.exampleCN: 一分钟之内凝结的水便盖满了玻璃杯外壁。
senses.why: Latin condensare 'to make dense' was applied by physics to vapour packing into liquid, since the same material becomes far denser.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 condensare「使变密」被物理学用于水汽聚成液体，因为同样的物质变得密得多。

senses.title: The drops that form on a cool surface
senses.definition: the small drops of liquid left on a cooler surface when vapour condenses
senses.definitionCN: 水汽凝结时在较冷表面上留下的小液滴
senses.example: He wiped the condensation from the bathroom mirror.
senses.exampleCN: 他擦掉了浴室镜面上的水珠。
senses.why: The result and the process share one noun, so the drops themselves are called condensation.
senses.whyCN: 结果与过程共用同一个名词，因此水珠本身也被称作 condensation。

senses.title: A chemical reaction joining two molecules
senses.definition: a reaction in which two molecules join and a small molecule such as water is released
senses.definitionCN: 两个分子结合并释放出一个小分子（如水）的反应
senses.example: The ester condensation released a molecule of water.
senses.exampleCN: 这步酯缩合释放出一分子水。
senses.why: Two molecules become one dense product while a fragment leaves, which chemists described with the same word as vapour packing together.
senses.whyCN: 两个分子合成一个紧密产物、同时留下一个小碎片，化学家便用与「水汽聚密」相同的词来描述。

senses.title: Deliberate liquefaction of a vapour
senses.titleCN: 有意把蒸汽液化的冷凝操作
senses.definition: the industrial or laboratory act of cooling a vapour so that it becomes liquid
senses.definitionCN: 工业或实验中通过降温使蒸汽变成液体的操作
senses.example: Condensation of the distillate began as soon as the coil cooled.
senses.exampleCN: 盘管一冷却，馏出物的冷凝就开始了。
senses.why: Technology turned the natural process into a controlled step, and kept the noun for the operation.
senses.whyCN: 技术把自然过程变成可控的工序，并沿用同一个名词指这项操作。

senses.title: Making a liquid more concentrated
senses.definition: the act of removing water or solvent so that a liquid becomes stronger
senses.definitionCN: 除去水或溶剂，使液体变得更浓的操作
senses.example: Slow condensation of the broth deepened its flavour.
senses.exampleCN: 汤汁慢慢浓缩，味道更浓了。
senses.why: Making a substance dense is the literal core of condensare, and removing water is the everyday way to do it.
senses.whyCN: 使物质变密是 condensare 的字面核心，而除去水分就是日常做法。

senses.title: Compressing writing or thought
senses.titleCN: 把文字或思想压缩凝练
senses.definition: the act of shortening a text or an argument while keeping its essential content
senses.definitionCN: 在保留核心内容的前提下压缩文字或论证
senses.example: The editing was an exercise in condensation, not deletion.
senses.exampleCN: 这次编辑是压缩凝练，而不是删削。
senses.why: Dense speech was pictured as vapour packed into drops, so shortening a text without losing meaning took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 浓缩的言语被比作水汽聚成液滴，因此在不丢内容的前提下缩短文本也用了同一个词。

senses.title: A shortened version of a text
senses.definition: a shortened form of a longer work, produced by condensing it
senses.definitionCN: 由长文压缩而成的简略版本
senses.example: The journal printed a condensation of the report.
senses.exampleCN: 期刊刊登了这份报告的简本。
senses.why: The product of condensing inherited the noun, so a condensation can be a thing you read.
senses.whyCN: 压缩的产物继承了同一个名词，因此 condensation 也可以指一篇可读的简本。

senses.title: Pressing powder into a dense solid
senses.definition: the densification of a powder or material by pressure or heat
senses.definitionCN: 通过压力或加热使粉末或材料致密化的过程
senses.example: Condensation of the powder gave a hard ceramic disc.
senses.exampleCN: 粉末经压制致密化，得到坚硬的陶瓷圆片。
senses.why: Materials science returned to the literal sense: particles brought close together until the mass is dense.
senses.whyCN: 材料学回到字面义：颗粒被压到一起，直到整体变得致密。

senses.title: A quantum state of shared particles
senses.definition: the process by which many particles fall into a single low-energy quantum state
senses.definitionCN: 大量粒子进入同一个低能量子态的过程
senses.example: The lab reached condensation at a fraction of a degree above absolute zero.
senses.exampleCN: 该实验室在略高于绝对零度处实现了凝聚。
senses.why: Physics extended density of number to density of state: many particles occupying one state, hence the same word.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把「数量之密」延伸为「状态之密」：大量粒子占据同一状态，因此沿用这个词。

intro.en: Condensation comes from Latin condensare 'to make dense', built on com- 'together' and densare 'to thicken' from densus 'dense'. The physics sense is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: condensation 来自拉丁 condensare「使变密」，由 com-「一起」与 densare「使变厚」构成，后者出自 densus「密的」。物理义是近代的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Densus meant 'thick, dense, crowded'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; the connection sometimes drawn to a root meaning 'to flow' is conjectural.
items.cn: densus 意为「浓的、密的、拥挤的」。其更深来源不确定；有人把它与一个意为「流」的词根相联系，那只是推测。

items.en: Densare 'to make thick' added the causative suffix -are to densus, giving a verb for crowding things together.
items.cn: densare「使变厚」由 densus 加使役后缀 -are 构成，表示把东西挤到一起。

items.en: Com- 'together' plus densare produced condensare 'to press together, make dense', used of air, liquids and writing alike.
items.cn: com-「一起」加 densare 构成 condensare「压紧、使密」，空气、液体与文字都可用它。

items.en: The verb entered English in the sixteenth century; the noun condensation followed, first for thickening and later for the change of state.
items.cn: 动词在十六世纪进入英语，名词 condensation 随后出现，先指变浓，后指物态变化。

items.en: From the nineteenth century chemistry named joining reactions and physics named vapour-to-liquid change with this word, both cases of parts packing closer.
items.cn: 从十九世纪起，化学用它命名结合反应，物理学用它命名气液转变，两者都是成分挤得更近。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin only): densus has no established ancestor, so every Indo-European form offered for it is a reconstruction. The first date of the noun is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅更深词源）：densus 没有已确定的祖先，凡为其提出的印欧形式均属重构。名词首见年代只能约计。

note.en: Group one holds look-alike nouns built on the same root with different endings; group two holds neighbours in the water cycle or in shortening.
note.cn: 第一组是同出一词根、词尾不同的形近名词；第二组是水循环或压缩缩短方面的近义词。

entries.definition: The liquid or solid left after condensation, a material rather than a process.
entries.definitionCN: 凝结之后留下的液体或固体，是物质而非过程。

entries.definition: A device built to condense vapour; the machine, not the change it produces.
entries.definitionCN: 用来冷凝蒸汽的装置；指机器而非它所引起的变化。

entries.definition: Reduction of volume by pressure, often without any change of state; condensation changes state, not always volume.
entries.definitionCN: 靠压力减小体积，通常不涉及物态变化；凝结改变的是物态。

entries.definition: The pressing of solid particles into a denser mass, close to the materials sense of condensation but with no vapour involved.
entries.definitionCN: 把固体颗粒压成更密的块体，接近 condensation 的材料义，但不涉及蒸汽。

entries.definition: Water falling from clouds as rain, snow or hail; condensation comes before it in the water cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 水以雨、雪或雹的形式从云中落下；在水循环中凝结先于它。

entries.definition: The change from liquid to vapour, the reverse of condensation.
entries.definitionCN: 由液态变为气态，是凝结的逆过程。

entries.definition: Shortening by cutting letters or syllables, a mechanical trim rather than the packed rewriting condensation implies.
entries.definitionCN: 靠删字母或音节来缩短，是机械删减，而非 condensation 所含的压缩改写。

entries.definition: A brief statement of the main points; a condensation of a text is one way to produce a summary.
entries.definitionCN: 对要点的简短陈述；文本的缩本正是产生摘要的一种方式。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: con- 'together' + densare 'make dense': the parts are packed together.
normal.cn: con-「一起」+ densare「使密」：把成分压到一起。

normal.en: The relative set is condense, condenser, condensate, condensable and condensed.
normal.cn: 同族词有 condense、condenser、condensate、condensable 与 condensed。

normal.en: Water changes state: evaporation up, condensation down. The two nouns are opposites.
normal.cn: 水的物态变化：上升是蒸发，下降是凝结，两个名词正好相反。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the science: condensation reaction, condensation point, condensation trail.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出科学义：缩合反应、凝点、凝结尾迹。

normal.en: The everyday sign is drops on a cold glass or on a bathroom mirror.
normal.cn: 日常标志是冷玻璃杯或浴室镜面上的水珠。

abstract.en: Picture a long letter folded smaller and smaller until only its core is left.
abstract.cn: 想象一封长信被折得越来越小，最后只剩核心。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd in a corridor pressed shoulder to shoulder.
abstract.cn: 想象走廊里的人被挤得肩挨着肩。

abstract.en: Picture mist touching a cold pane and turning into beads you can wipe.
abstract.cn: 想象雾气碰到冷玻璃，变成可以擦掉的珠子。

examples.en: Condensation on the inner pane froze overnight into fern-like patterns.
examples.cn: 内层窗玻璃上的凝结水一夜之间冻成了蕨叶状花纹。

examples.en: The reaction is a condensation that gives off one molecule of water.
examples.cn: 这个反应是脱去一分子水的缩合。

examples.en: Readers preferred the condensation to the full three-volume report.
examples.cn: 读者更喜欢那份三卷报告的简本。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「con（共同）+ dense（密）」——水汽挤到一起变密，就成了水珠 → 凝结

root: 拉丁 condensare「压紧、使密」= com-（一起）+ densare（使变厚）← densus「密的」；densus 更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one gesture: parts are pressed closer. Vapour becomes drops, drops coat a glass, molecules join, liquids thicken, texts shorten, and finally many particles share one quantum state.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿同一个动作展开：把成分压得更近。水汽变成水珠，水珠铺在杯壁上，分子彼此结合，液体变浓，文字变短，最后大量粒子共处一个量子态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: vapour crowding onto a cold surface until it becomes visible liquid.
core.cn: 核心意象：水汽挤到冷表面上，直到变成看得见的液体。

branches.en: CHANGE OF STATE: natural cooling and controlled liquefaction are the same transition.
branches.cn: 物态变化：自然冷却与受控液化是同一种转变。

branches.en: DENSER RESULT: drops on a pane and a thickened broth both show material packed closer.
branches.cn: 更密的结果：窗上的水珠与变浓的汤汁都显示物质挤得更紧。

branches.en: MOLECULES JOIN: chemistry applies packing to bonds, with a small fragment leaving.
branches.cn: 分子结合：化学把「挤紧」用于化学键，同时放出小碎片。

branches.en: TEXT PACKED: meaning is kept while the wording is squeezed, and the squeezed product is readable.
branches.cn: 文字压缩：词句被挤压而意义保留，压出的成品可以阅读。

branches.en: MATTER AND STATE PRESSED: powder densifies, and particles crowd into one state.
branches.cn: 物质与状态被压紧：粉末致密化，粒子挤进同一状态。

intro.en: Condensation is a Latin verbal noun whose prefix, root and suffix all recur in English technical vocabulary.
intro.cn: condensation 是拉丁动词性名词，其前缀、词根与后缀在英语科技词汇中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Latin densus 'dense' gives dense, density and densify; com- 'together' also appears in combine and compress.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 densus「密的」衍生 dense、density 与 densify；com-「一起」也出现在 combine 与 compress 中。

items.example: The prefix says the parts are brought together.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀表示成分被聚到一起。

items.example: A dense fog closed the road.

items.exampleCN: 这份笔记把论证压缩了。

latinEntries.structure: densus, densa, densum (adjective, first and second declension)

definition_zh: 条件；状况；环境；使适应；护理
definition_en: something that must exist before something else can happen, or the state something is in
core_image: 一个人反复擦拭旧手表，让它保持准确的走时
scene: 二手车商把每辆车的状况写在小牌上。The condition of the tyres decides the price.
sceneCN: 这里 condition 指「状况」（第 2 个义项：人或物所处的状态）；句意是轮胎的状况决定价格。

senses.title: Something required first
senses.definition: a thing that must happen or exist before something else is possible
senses.definitionCN: 必须先发生或存在，其他事才可能实现的事
senses.example: Patience is a condition of good teaching.
senses.exampleCN: 耐心是做好教学的一个条件。
senses.why: A door needs a key before it can open, and a result needs its condition.
senses.whyCN: 门要先有钥匙才能开，结果也要先有条件。

senses.title: The state of something
senses.definition: the physical state that a person or thing is in
senses.definitionCN: 人或物在身体或物理上的状态
senses.example: The car is still in good condition.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车状况仍然良好。
senses.why: You judge a thing by how well it still does its job.
senses.whyCN: 判断一件东西，就看它还能把本分做得多好。

senses.title: Train or care for
senses.definition: to train someone to react in a certain way, or to keep something healthy
senses.definitionCN: 训练某人形成某种反应，或使某物保持良好状态
senses.example: The animals were conditioned to accept people.
senses.exampleCN: 这些动物被训练得能接受人类。
senses.why: Repeated practice shapes a response, and repeated care keeps a thing fit.
senses.whyCN: 反复练习塑造反应，反复护理让东西保持良好。

intro.en: Condition comes from Latin condicio, an agreement or situation, from condicere, to talk something over together.
intro.cn: condition 来自拉丁语 condicio，意为约定或情形，源自动词 condicere（一起商谈）。

items.en: Condicere joined com-, together, with dicere, to say.
items.cn: condicere 由 com-（一起）与 dicere（说）组合而成。

items.en: Condicio named the terms that two sides agreed on.
items.cn: condicio 指双方商定的条款。

items.en: Old French condition kept both the agreement and the state senses.
items.cn: 古法语 condition 同时保留了约定与状况两种含义。

items.en: English condition first meant a stated requirement.
items.cn: 英语 condition 最初指明确提出的要求。

items.en: It now also covers health, surroundings and the training of behaviour.
items.cn: 如今它也覆盖健康、环境与行为训练。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words with a similar ending, and the meaning group names other words for a state or a requirement.
note.cn: 形近组收的是词尾相近的词，近义组列出其他表示状态或要求的词。

entries.definition: the passing of heat or electricity through something
a strong belief or a court judgement
an opinion argued for in a dispute
the way something is at a certain time
the set of things happening at one time
something that is needed or demanded

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a contract, then move to the state of a car and to trained behaviour.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一份契约开始，再走到汽车的状况与训练出的行为。

normal.en: Con- is together and dic- is say, so a condition is something two sides say together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，dic- 是说，所以 condition 是双方一起说定的事。

normal.en: A contract lists conditions, and a used car has a condition too.
normal.cn: 合同列出条件，二手车也有自己的状况。

normal.en: On condition that means only if the other side keeps its word.
normal.cn: on condition that 的意思就是只有对方守约才行。

normal.en: Conditioner keeps hair in good condition.
normal.cn: 护发素让头发保持良好状态。

normal.en: An athlete conditions the body by repeating the same move.
normal.cn: 运动员靠重复同一个动作来训练身体。

abstract.en: Picture two hands signing the same sheet of paper.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在同一张纸上签字。

abstract.en: Picture a gauge that shows how much life is left.
abstract.cn: 想象一个显示还剩多少寿命的仪表。

abstract.en: Picture water slowly shaping a stone day by day.
abstract.cn: 想象水一天天慢慢塑造一块石头。

examples.en: Hard work is one condition of success.
examples.cn: 努力是成功的一个条件。

examples.en: The house is in excellent condition.
examples.cn: 这栋房子的状况极好。

examples.en: Years of training conditioned her to stay calm.
examples.cn: 多年训练让她习惯于保持冷静。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 condition 记成 con（一起）加 dit（说）加 ion：双方一起说定的条款是条件，说定的当下情形就是状况。

root: 源自拉丁语 condicio（com 一起 + dicere 说），本义是双方说定的条款，后引申为条件、状况与环境。

sensesIntro.en: From agreed terms, to the state of a thing, and finally to the shaping of behaviour.
sensesIntro.cn: 从商定的条款，到事物的状态，最后到行为的塑造。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people agree on terms, and a gauge shows how well things stand.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人谈定条款，同时一个仪表显示现状如何。

branches.en: A condition is what must be true before the result can follow.
branches.cn: 条件是结果出现之前必须成立的事。

branches.en: The state sense asks how well something still works.
branches.cn: 状况义项关心的是某物还能运转得多好。

branches.en: Training and care both aim at keeping a good state.
branches.cn: 训练与护理都以保持良好状态为目标。

branches.en: Terms and states are both fixed points you can check.
branches.cn: 条款与状态都是可以核对的固定点。

branches.en: Good care today is the condition of good condition tomorrow.
branches.cn: 今天的良好护理，是明天状况良好的条件。

intro.en: Condition is built on Latin com-, together, plus dicere, to say, with the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: condition 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、dicere（说）与名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin say base dic- also appears in predict and dictionary.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的说话词基 dic- 也出现在 predict 与 dictionary 中。

items.meaning: to train or keep in a good state
items.exampleCN: 入冬前先护理一下皮革。

items.meaning: trained to react in a certain way
items.example: The dog was conditioned to sit still.
items.exampleCN: 这只狗被训练得能安静坐着。

items.meaning: the process of training a response
items.exampleCN: 这项研究考察恐惧条件作用。

items.example: The offer is conditional on approval.
items.exampleCN: 这个提议以获批为条件。

items.meaning: in a way that depends on something
a product or device that improves something
items.example: She bought a new hair conditioner.
items.exampleCN: 她买了一瓶新的护发素。

items.meaning: a system that controls room temperature
items.example: The air conditioning failed in summer.

definition_zh: n. 护发素；调节剂，调节器
definition_en: a product or device that puts something into a better condition
core_image: 洗完头发后挤在掌心的一小团顺滑乳霜
scene: 她洗完头，挤了一点抹在发梢上，头发立刻顺滑起来。After washing her hair, she worked a little conditioner into the ends and it turned smooth at once.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：conditioner 指护发素；句意是她洗完头抹上护发素，发梢立刻顺滑。

senses.title: Hair softener
senses.definition: a cream you put on hair after washing to make it soft
senses.definitionCN: 洗发后抹在头发上使其柔软的乳霜
senses.example: This conditioner leaves my hair smooth.
senses.exampleCN: 这款护发素让我的头发顺滑。
senses.why: The product conditions, that is, improves the hair.
senses.whyCN: 该产品「调理」即改善发质。

senses.title: Air or fabric adjuster
senses.definition: a device or additive that keeps air or cloth in a good state
senses.definitionCN: 让空气或织物保持良好状态的装置或添加物
senses.example: The air conditioner broke in the heat.

senses.title: Electric current through a material
senses.definition: the flow of electric charge through a substance when a voltage is applied
senses.definitionCN: 施加电压时电荷在物质中的流动
senses.example: The salt solution supports electrical conduction.
senses.exampleCN: 盐溶液可以导电。
senses.why: Electricity was understood as a flow that is 'led' through a wire, so the same noun was reused.
senses.whyCN: 电被理解为一种被「引导」通过导线的流动，于是沿用了同一个名词。

senses.title: Ionic conduction in solutions
senses.definition: charge transport by ions moving through a liquid or a solid electrolyte
senses.definitionCN: 离子在液体或固体电解质中移动而完成的电荷输运
senses.example: Ionic conduction in the battery depends on how freely the ions move.
senses.exampleCN: 电池中的离子传导取决于离子移动的自由程度。
senses.why: Here the carriers are whole ions rather than electrons, but the leading-through image is unchanged.
senses.whyCN: 这里的载体是整个离子而非电子，但「引导穿过」的意象没有改变。

senses.title: Nerve signal conduction
senses.definition: the passage of an electrical impulse along a nerve fibre
senses.definitionCN: 电冲动沿神经纤维的传递
senses.example: Damage to the sheath slows nerve conduction.
senses.exampleCN: 髓鞘受损会减慢神经传导。
senses.why: Physiology borrowed the physics word because a signal also travels along a pathway without the pathway moving.
senses.whyCN: 生理学借用了物理词，因为信号同样沿路径行进，而路径本身不动。

senses.title: Sound conduction
senses.definition: the passing of sound vibrations through a solid, liquid or gas, especially through the ear
senses.definitionCN: 声音振动通过固体、液体或气体传递，尤指经过耳部
senses.example: Bone conduction lets you hear a vibration through your skull.
senses.exampleCN: 骨传导让你能通过颅骨听到振动。
senses.why: Vibration travelling through matter is another case of something being led along a medium.
senses.whyCN: 振动穿过物质，同样是某物被沿着介质引导而行的情形。

senses.title: Leading or guidance
senses.definition: the act of leading, guiding or managing something, the earliest sense of the word in English
senses.definitionCN: 引导、指导或管理某事的动作，这是该词进入英语时最早的意思
senses.example: The old text speaks of the conduction of a household.
senses.exampleCN: 这份旧文献谈到对一个家庭的治理。
senses.why: The modern scientific senses all grow from this plain sense of leading: heat, charge and signals are all led along.
senses.whyCN: 现代科学义都从「引导」这一朴素义生长出来：热、电荷与信号都是被引导着走的。

senses.title: Heat loss through a building
senses.titleCN: 建筑围护结构的热传导
senses.definition: the rate at which heat passes through walls, windows and roofs into or out of a building
senses.definitionCN: 热穿过墙体、窗户与屋顶进出建筑的速率
senses.example: Double glazing reduces conduction through the window.
senses.exampleCN: 双层玻璃减少了通过窗户的热传导。
senses.why: Building science applies the solid-state process to the fabric of a house.
senses.whyCN: 建筑科学把固体传热过程套用到房屋的围护结构上。

senses.title: Conduction in semiconductors
senses.definition: charge transport by electrons and holes in a material whose conductivity lies between a metal and an insulator
senses.definitionCN: 在导电性介于金属与绝缘体之间的材料中，由电子与空穴完成的电荷输运
senses.example: Doping raises the conduction of silicon at room temperature.
senses.exampleCN: 掺杂提高了硅在室温下的导电能力。
senses.why: The band model describes two kinds of carrier, but both are still conducted through the lattice.
senses.whyCN: 能带模型描述了两种载流子，但两者都仍是穿过晶格被传导的。

intro.en: Conduction comes from Latin conducere 'to lead or bring together', built on com- 'together' and ducere 'to lead'. The word entered English first as 'guidance' and only later became a term for heat, charge and nerve signals.
intro.cn: conduction 来自拉丁 conducere「引导、聚拢」，由 com-「一起」与 ducere「引导」构成。它进入英语时先表示「引导」，后来才成为热、电荷与神经信号方面的术语。

items.en: Ducere meant 'to lead, draw, guide', with the past participle ductus; it also gives duct, duke and induce.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导、拉、带领」，过去分词为 ductus；它还给出 duct、duke 与 induce。

items.en: Com- 'together' plus ducere produced conducere 'to lead together, bring along, hire'.
items.cn: com-「一起」加 ducere 构成 conducere「引导到一起、带来、雇用」。

items.en: The action noun conductio 'a leading, hiring' supplied the form that English borrowed.
items.cn: 动作名词 conductio「引导、雇用」提供了英语借入的形式。

items.en: In Middle English conduction meant leading or guidance; the scientific senses are much later additions.
items.cn: 在中古英语中，conduction 意为引导或管理；科学义是后来才加上的。

items.en: The heat and electricity senses date from the nineteenth century; the exact first use in each field is uncertain.
items.cn: 热与电的义项始于 19 世纪；各领域确切的最早使用不确定。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same Latin root that are easily confused; group two holds the other heat-transfer modes and related transport words.
note.cn: 第一组是同出拉丁词根、容易混淆的形式；第二组是其他传热方式与相关的输运词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to lead, carry out or transmit, and the noun for a person's behaviour; conduction is only the process noun.
entries.definitionCN: 动词意为引导、进行或传输，名词指人的行为；conduction 只是表示过程的名词。

entries.definition: A material or person that conducts heat, electricity, sound or an orchestra; it names the agent, not the process.
entries.definitionCN: 传导热、电、声的材料，或指挥乐队的人；它指施动者而非过程。

entries.definition: The degree to which a material conducts heat or electricity, a quantity rather than the flow itself.
entries.definitionCN: 材料传导热或电的程度，是一个量，而不是流动本身。

entries.definition: A pipe or channel through which something passes, from the same root but naming the physical channel.
entries.definitionCN: 让某物通过的管道或通道，同出该词根，但指实物通道。

entries.definition: Heat transfer by a moving fluid; in conduction the material stays put while energy passes through it.
entries.definitionCN: 由流动的流体传热；传导中材料本身不动，能量穿过它。

entries.definition: Heat transfer by electromagnetic waves, needing no material medium at all.
entries.definitionCN: 以电磁波传热，完全不需要物质介质。

entries.definition: The general passing of energy, signals or disease from one place to another, without specifying the mechanism.
entries.definitionCN: 能量、信号或疾病从一处传到另一处的泛称，不指明机制。

entries.definition: The spreading of particles from high to low concentration; it moves matter itself rather than leading energy through a fixed lattice.
entries.definitionCN: 粒子由高浓度向低浓度散开；它移动的是物质本身，而非让能量穿过固定晶格。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: a real Latin root, a real word family and real physics collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词根、真实词族与真实物理搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: con- 'together' + ducere 'lead': energy is led through the material.
normal.cn: con-「一起」+ ducere「引导」：能量被引导穿过材料。

normal.en: The root family runs conduct, conductor, conductivity, conduit.
normal.cn: 词根词族包括 conduct、conductor、conductivity、conduit。

normal.en: Physics pairs it with convection and radiation as the three modes of heat transfer.
normal.cn: 物理学把它与 convection、radiation 并列为三种传热方式。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: heat conduction, electrical conduction, conduction band.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：热传导、导电、导带。

normal.en: The oldest sense is guidance; every later sense keeps the idea of something being led along.
normal.cn: 最古老的义项是引导；后来每个义项都保留「某物被引导着前行」的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a line of people passing buckets along until the last one gets water.
abstract.cn: 想象一排人依次传递水桶，直到最后一个人接到水。

abstract.en: Picture a whisper travelling down a row of seated students without anyone moving seats.
abstract.cn: 想象一句耳语沿一排坐着的学生传下去，没有人换座位。

abstract.en: Picture a copper spoon in a hot pot, its handle warming long before it is touched.
abstract.cn: 想象热锅里的铜勺，还没碰到，勺柄就已经暖了。

examples.en: Silver has excellent conduction, which is why it is used in some contacts.
examples.cn: 银的导电性极好，因此被用于某些触点。

examples.en: Thick insulation slows conduction through the walls.
examples.cn: 厚保温层减缓了通过墙体的热传导。

examples.en: The doctor ordered a test of nerve conduction in the arm.
examples.cn: 医生安排了手臂神经传导的检查。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯导」——热肯沿着棒子一路导过去，就是传导

root: 拉丁 conducere「引导、聚拢」= com-「一起」+ ducere「引导」，动作名词 conductio。英语先有「引导、管理」义，热、电、神经等科学义始于 19 世纪；各领域最早书证不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one line: something is led through a medium that itself stays still, whether that something is heat, charge, an ion, a nerve impulse, sound, or the older idea of guidance itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条线索展开：某物被引导穿过本身不动的介质，无论那是热、电荷、离子、神经冲动、声音，还是更早的「引导」这一本义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: heat walking along a metal rod while the rod stays where it is.
core.cn: 核心意象：热沿着金属棒走过去，而棒子本身停在原处。

branches.en: HEAT IN MATTER: the same process is measured in a rod and in a house wall.
branches.cn: 物质中的热：同一过程既在金属棒上测量，也在房屋墙体上测量。

branches.en: CHARGE CARRIERS: electrons and ions both conduct, though the carriers differ.
branches.cn: 电荷载体：电子与离子都能传导，只是载体不同。

branches.en: LIVING AND VIBRATING SIGNALS: nerves and sound repeat the same leading-through pattern.
branches.cn: 生命与振动信号：神经与声音重复同样的引导模式。

branches.en: THE ORIGINAL SENSE: guidance is the plain meaning from which the science grew.
branches.cn: 本义：引导是科学义生长出来的朴素含义。

branches.en: SEMICONDUCTORS: two kinds of carrier share one lattice.
branches.cn: 半导体：两种载流子共用一套晶格。

intro.en: Conduction is con- plus the root duc- plus -tion; the same three pieces build a large and very common family.
intro.cn: conduction 是 con- 加词根 duc- 再加 -tion；同样三块构成一个庞大而常见的词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is well recorded: ducere 'to lead', conducere 'to lead together', conductio 'a leading', and the participle ductus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词族记载完整：ducere「引导」、conducere「引导到一起」、conductio「引导」以及分词 ductus。

items.example: The prefix gathers the leading into one movement.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把引导收束为一次整体运动。

items.example: The root also appears in induce and duct.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也出现在 induce 与 duct 中。

items.meaning: the act or result of an action
items.example: The suffix turns the verb into the name of a process.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动词变成过程之名。

items.meaning: to lead, carry out or transmit

items.structure: conduct + -or (one who or that which acts)
items.meaning: a material that transmits heat or electricity
items.example: A conductor carries charge to the ground.

items.meaning: able to conduct heat or electricity
items.example: The gel is conductive and harmless to skin.
items.exampleCN: 这种凝胶导电且对皮肤无害。

items.example: Copper's conductivity is higher than iron's.

items.meaning: a pipe or channel for passing something
items.meaningCN: 输送某物的管道或通道
items.example: Water ran through the stone conduit.

items.meaning: the ease with which a component conducts
items.example: The circuit's conductance fell as it warmed.
items.exampleCN: 电路升温时其电导下降。

latinEntries.meaning: to lead together, bring along, hire

definition_zh: 导电的；导热的；有助于……的
definition_en: able to carry heat or electricity, or able to help something happen

senses.title: Carrying electric charge
senses.definition: able to carry electric charge from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 能把电荷从一处送到另一处
senses.example: The salt solution becomes conductive once the ions separate.
senses.exampleCN: 离子一旦分开，盐溶液就变得导电。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant leading along, and the suffix adds a tendency: a conductive material tends to let charge travel through it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「引导」，后缀又加上「倾向」：导电材料倾向于让电荷穿过。

senses.title: Carrying heat
senses.definition: able to carry heat from a warmer place to a cooler one
senses.definitionCN: 能把热从较热处传到较冷处
senses.example: The copper strip proved so conductive that the wax melted within seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 铜条导热太好，蜡几秒就融化了。
senses.why: Heat and charge both move through the same solids in the same way, so one adjective serves the two cases.
senses.whyCN: 热与电荷在同样的固体里以同样的方式移动，因此一个形容词同时服务两种情形。

senses.title: Able to pass something through
senses.titleCN: 可传导的：能让某种能量通过
senses.definition: able to let a form of energy or a signal pass through a medium
senses.definitionCN: 能让某种能量或信号穿过介质
senses.example: The gel is conductive to ultrasound but not to light.
senses.exampleCN: 这种凝胶能传导超声，却不能让光通过。
senses.why: The core of the word is passage rather than electricity, so it applies to sound, light and other signals when a medium carries them.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的核心是「通过」，而不是电，因此当介质运送声音、光等信号时也能用它。

senses.title: Strongly conductive
senses.titleCN: 导电或导热性强的；良导的
senses.definition: having a high ability to carry charge or heat
senses.definitionCN: 传导电荷或热的能力很强
senses.example: Silver is the most conductive metal, which is why it is used in contacts.
senses.exampleCN: 银是导电性最强的金属，因此常用于触点。
senses.why: The adjective is gradable: materials are compared by how much they pass, so it also means strongly conductive.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词有程度差别：材料按通过量比较，因此它也指「传导性强的」。

senses.title: Of conductance
senses.titleCN: 电导的；与传导率有关的
senses.definition: relating to conductivity or to the measured ease of passing current
senses.definitionCN: 与传导率或以数值衡量的通电难易有关
senses.example: The team measured the conductive properties of the alloy at low temperature.
senses.exampleCN: 团队测量了这种合金在低温下的电导特性。
senses.why: Once the ability is expressed as a number, the adjective attaches to measurements and technical descriptions.
senses.whyCN: 当这种能力被表示成数值，形容词就附着在测量与技术描述上。

senses.title: Of sound reaching the ear
senses.titleCN: 传导性听力损失的（医学）
senses.definition: relating to sound being blocked in its path to the inner ear rather than to the nerve
senses.definitionCN: 指声音在到达内耳的路途中受阻，而不是神经本身出问题
senses.example: Conductive hearing loss improves when the blockage is removed.
senses.exampleCN: 传导性听力损失在阻塞被清除后会改善。
senses.why: Medicine borrowed the word for a pathway problem: the sound is fine, but its conduction through the ear is interrupted.
senses.whyCN: 医学借用了这个词来表示通路问题：声音本身没问题，是它在耳内的传导被中断了。

senses.title: Helping something happen
senses.definition: tending to help or promote a result, often followed by to
senses.definitionCN: 倾向于促成某种结果，常接 to
senses.example: A quiet room is conductive to concentration.
senses.exampleCN: 安静的屋子有助于集中注意力。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the idea of a path: conditions that are conductive to something make it easy for that thing to travel toward its result.
senses.whyCN: 这个隐喻保留了通路的意思：有利于某事的条件，让那件事更容易走向结果。

senses.title: Likely to set off a reaction
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：容易引发某种结果或氛围的
senses.definition: likely to bring about a particular mood, reaction or outcome
senses.definitionCN: 容易带来某种气氛、反应或结果
senses.example: That rumour was conductive to panic in the crowded hall.
senses.exampleCN: 那条谣言很容易在拥挤的大厅里引发恐慌。
senses.why: The abstract sense pushes the path idea into cause: what is conductive to panic lets panic spread as if along a wire.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义把通路推向因果：有利于恐慌的东西，让恐慌像沿导线一样扩散。

intro.en: Conductive is conduct plus the Latin suffix -ive, from the verb conducere 'to lead together'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: conductive 是 conduct 加拉丁后缀 -ive 构成，源自动词 conducere「一起引导」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Conducere joined com- 'together' with ducere 'to lead', giving the sense of bringing something along a path.
items.cn: conducere 由 com-「一起」与 ducere「引导」构成，意为把某物沿一条路带过去。

items.en: Later Latin formed conductivus, 'tending to lead or carry', which English took as conductive in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语构成 conductivus，意为「有引导、运送倾向的」，英语在十七世纪借入作 conductive。

items.en: Early English uses described substances that carry heat or fluid, long before the word was tied to electricity.
items.cn: 早期英语用法描述能传热或传流体的物质，远在它被绑定到电之前。

items.en: Eighteenth- and nineteenth-century experimenters applied it to materials that pass charge, and conductivity became its measured noun.
items.cn: 十八、十九世纪的实验者用它指能通过电荷的材料，conductivity 成为其可测量的名词形式。

items.en: The phrase conductive to, meaning helpful to a result, is recorded from the seventeenth century and grew alongside the physical sense.
items.cn: conductive to 表示有助于某种结果，自十七世纪起有记录，与物理义同时发展。

items.en: Twentieth-century audiology used conductive for sound blocked on its way through the outer or middle ear.
items.cn: 二十世纪的听力学用 conductive 指声音在外耳或中耳通道上受阻。

note.en: Group one holds derivatives of the same Latin verb; group two holds words about passing or helping things through.
note.cn: 第一组是同一拉丁动词的派生词；第二组是关于让东西通过或促成的词。

entries.definition: To carry or lead; conductive describes the ability to do so.
entries.definitionCN: 运送或引导；conductive 描述具备这种能力。

entries.definition: The process of carrying heat or charge through a material.
entries.definitionCN: 热或电荷通过材料的过程。

entries.definition: The material or person that carries; the adjective describes it.
entries.definitionCN: 承载或引导的材料或人；形容词描述这一性质。

entries.definition: How well a material conducts, expressed as a number.
entries.definitionCN: 材料传导能力的数值表示。

entries.definition: Actively sending energy or signals onward, often with a device attached.
entries.definitionCN: 主动把能量或信号送出去，常涉及具体装置。

entries.definition: Allows fluids or gases to pass through pores; not used for charge.
entries.definitionCN: 允许流体或气体穿过孔隙；不用于电荷。

entries.definition: Preventing heat or charge from passing; the exact reverse of conductive.
entries.definitionCN: 阻止热或电荷通过，正是 conductive 的反面。

entries.definition: The plain word for conditions that help something succeed, close to conductive to.
entries.definitionCN: 表示条件有助于成功的平实说法，接近 conductive to。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin verb, the real suffixes, and the real split between electricity and help.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁动词、真实的后缀，以及电学义与「有助于」义的真实分工。

normal.en: The root is lead: conduct, conductor, conduction and conductivity all describe something travelling along a path.
normal.cn: 词根是「引导」：conduct、conductor、conduction、conductivity 都描述沿通路行进的过程。

normal.en: The suffix -ive adds a tendency: a conductive material tends to let energy through.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ive 加「倾向」：导电材料倾向于让能量通过。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the physics: conductive material, electrically conductive, thermally conductive.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出物理义：导电材料、电导的、导热的。

normal.en: The same adjective turns social: a quiet room is conductive to concentration.
normal.cn: 同一个形容词也转向社会语境：安静的屋子有助于集中注意力。

normal.en: Medicine keeps the path picture: conductive hearing loss is a blockage on the way in, not a damaged nerve.
normal.cn: 医学保留了通路图景：传导性听力损失是入口堵塞，而不是神经受损。

abstract.en: Picture heat walking down a copper rod hand over hand.
abstract.cn: 想象热沿着铜棒一手接一手地往下走。

abstract.en: Picture a hall with the doors open, so sound walks in without effort.

to reach a conclusion from evidence
to give something formally or legally
to give an honour as a gift
to ask someone for advice or information

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a medal on a stage, then move to a small circle of judges and to a gift of rights.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从台上的奖章开始，再走到围坐的评委与一份权利的赠予。

normal.en: Con- is together and fer- is carry, so confer is to carry something to someone.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，fer- 是携带，所以 confer 就是把东西送到别人那里。

normal.en: A degree conferred is a paper carried across a stage.
normal.cn: 被授予的学位，就是一张被带上台的纸。

normal.en: Judges confer because a decision carried by several minds weighs more.
normal.cn: 评委要商议，因为几个人共同作出的决定更有分量。

normal.en: Confer with a friend before you confer a promise.
normal.cn: 在给出承诺之前，先和朋友商议一下。

normal.en: The same word gives an honour and asks for advice.
normal.cn: 同一个词，既给出荣誉，也征求建议。

abstract.en: Picture a medal laid in an open hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚奖章被放进摊开的手掌。

abstract.en: Picture three chairs pulled into a tight circle.
abstract.cn: 想象三把椅子被拉成一个紧圈。

abstract.en: Picture two maps laid side by side on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象两张地图并排摊在桌上。

examples.en: The college conferred an honorary degree on her.
examples.cn: 学院授予她荣誉学位。

examples.en: The doctors conferred before they began the operation.
examples.cn: 医生们在手术开始前进行了商议。

examples.en: You should confer with your family first.
examples.cn: 你应该先和家人商量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 confer 记成 con（一起）加 fer（带）：把荣誉带给人是授予，把问题带到一起讨论就是商议。

root: 源自拉丁语 conferre（com 一起 + ferre 携带），本义是带到一起，后引申为比较、商议与授予。

sensesIntro.en: From carrying things into one place, to talking a matter over, and finally to handing an honour to someone.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把东西带到一处，到把事情放在一起讨论，最后到把荣誉交到某人手上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people bring their views to one table, and one brings a gift to the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人把看法带到同一张桌上，同时一个人把礼物递给另一个人。

branches.en: An honour is carried from the giver to the receiver.
branches.cn: 荣誉从授予者手中被送到接受者那里。

branches.en: A discussion brings several minds into one place.
branches.cn: 商议把几个人的想法带到同一个地方。

branches.en: Both senses depend on bringing people or things together.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖把人或事物带到一起。

branches.en: The act of conferring is the short meeting before a decision.
branches.cn: 商议就是做决定前的那场短会。

branches.en: The giving sense carries the same image into ceremony.
branches.cn: 授予义项把同一个意象带进了典礼。

intro.en: Confer is built on Latin com-, together, plus ferre, to carry.
intro.cn: confer 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 ferre（携带）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin carry base fer- also appears in transfer, refer and offer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的携带词基 fer- 也出现在 transfer、refer 与 offer 中。

items.exampleCN: 这个头衔带来很大的尊重。

items.example: They are conferring in the next room.
items.exampleCN: 他们正在隔壁房间商议。

items.meaning: the act of giving an honour
items.exampleCN: 这次授予在安静中完成。

items.meaning: the giving of a degree or right
items.example: The conferral of the prize was delayed.
They transferred the file to a new drive.
items.exampleCN: 他们把文件转到了新硬盘上。

definition_zh: 会议；研讨会；协商
definition_en: a large meeting where people discuss a subject or share ideas
core_image: 长桌两旁坐满人，每人面前一支麦克风
scene: 各地医生聚在大厅里交流新研究。She met her future partner at a medical conference.
sceneCN: 这里 conference 指「会议」（第 1 个义项：多人聚集讨论专业问题的场合）；句意是她在一次医学会议上遇见了未来的伴侣。

senses.title: A large formal meeting
senses.definition: a large meeting where people discuss a shared subject
senses.definitionCN: 许多人聚集讨论共同主题的大型会议
senses.example: The annual conference drew two thousand guests.
senses.exampleCN: 年度会议吸引了两千名来宾。
senses.why: A shared subject gives strangers a reason to sit in one room.
senses.whyCN: 共同的主题让陌生人有了坐进同一个房间的理由。

senses.title: A private discussion
senses.definition: a private discussion between a few people before a decision
senses.definitionCN: 少数人在做决定前的私下商谈
senses.example: After a short conference, the two sides agreed.
senses.exampleCN: 短暂商谈之后，双方达成了一致。
senses.why: Some words are said best when only a few people are listening.
senses.whyCN: 有些话在只有少数人听的时候最好说。

intro.en: Conference comes from Latin conferentia, a bringing together, from conferre, to bring together.
intro.cn: conference 来自拉丁语 conferentia，意为聚集，源自 conferre（带到一起）。

items.en: Conferre meant to carry people or ideas into one place.
items.cn: conferre 意为把人或想法带到同一个地方。

items.en: Conferentia named the state of being gathered together.
items.cn: conferentia 指被聚集到一起的状态。

items.en: French conference named a formal meeting for talks.
items.cn: 法语 conference 指为商谈而举行的正式会面。

items.en: English conference first meant a conversation between parties.
items.cn: 英语 conference 最初指各方之间的交谈。

items.en: It now mainly names a large meeting of people with a shared interest.
items.cn: 如今它主要指有共同兴趣的人举行的大型会议。

note.en: The look-alike group holds nouns built from the same Latin root, and the meaning group names other kinds of gathering.
note.cn: 形近组收的是由同一拉丁词根构成的名词，近义组列出其他类型的聚会。

entries.definition: the act of giving an honour
the giving of a degree or right
the place where two rivers meet
an event where people come together to talk
a large meeting of people with one interest
a small class for discussion and study

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a long table full of microphones, then move to a small closed room and to name badges.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从摆满麦克风的长桌开始，再走到一间关起门的小屋与一排名牌。

normal.en: Confer plus -ence is the noun of bringing people together.
normal.cn: confer 加 -ence，就是把人们聚到一起这件事的名词。

normal.en: A conference is a room where every chair faces the same screen.
normal.cn: 会议就是每把椅子都朝向同一块屏幕的房间。

normal.en: A press conference is a short meeting built for questions.
normal.cn: 记者招待会就是为提问而设的短会。

normal.en: The conference badge tells others which subject you came for.
normal.cn: 会议名牌会告诉别人你是为哪个主题而来。

normal.en: In conference, people confer, and then they return to work.
normal.cn: 在会议里人们商议，然后回到工作中。

abstract.en: Picture a forest of name cards on a long table.
abstract.cn: 想象一长桌上立起一片名牌。

abstract.en: Picture a hundred voices dropping to a whisper.
abstract.cn: 想象上百个声音一起降到耳语。

abstract.en: Picture one slide lighting a dark hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一张幻灯片照亮昏暗的大厅。

examples.en: She gave a talk at the conference on climate.
examples.cn: 她在气候会议上做了报告。

examples.en: The two leaders held a private conference.
examples.cn: 两位领导人举行了私下商谈。

examples.en: Our conference room is booked all morning.
examples.cn: 我们的会议室整个上午都被订满了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conference 记成 confer（带到一起）加 ence：把许多人带到同一个房间，就是会议。

root: 源自拉丁语 conferentia（con 一起 + ferre 携带），本义是聚到一起，后指大型会议与私下协商。

sensesIntro.en: From people carried into one hall, to a few people talking behind a door, and finally to the meeting itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被带进同一大厅的人群，到关起门交谈的少数人，最后到会议本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many chairs, one long table, and everyone facing the same subject.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多椅子、一张长桌，所有人都朝向同一个主题。

branches.en: The large meeting is the public and formal side of the word.
branches.cn: 大型会议是这个词公开而正式的一面。

branches.en: The private talk is the same idea behind a closed door.
branches.cn: 私下商谈是同一个意思关起门来的样子。

branches.en: Both sizes of meeting exist to move a subject forward.
branches.cn: 两种规模的会议都为了推动一个议题。

branches.en: A conference is measured by what people carry home from it.
branches.cn: 衡量一场会议，看人们从中带走了什么。

branches.en: A short conference can settle what a long debate cannot.
branches.cn: 一场短商谈有时能解决长辩论解决不了的事。

intro.en: Conference is Latin com-, together, plus ferre, to carry, with the noun ending -ence.
intro.cn: conference 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、ferre（携带）与名词词尾 -ence 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin carry base fer- also appears in transfer and refer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的携带词基 fer- 也出现在 transfer 与 refer 中。

items.example: She attends three conferences a year.

items.exampleCN: 评审团今晚将进行商议。

items.example: The conferment of the medal was brief.
The conferral of rights took years.
items.exampleCN: 这些权利的授予花了好几年。

items.meaning: holding meetings by phone or video
items.example: The team uses video conferencing daily.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队每天使用视频会议。

items.meaning: a meeting held to answer journalists
items.example: The coach called a press conference.
items.exampleCN: 教练召开了一场记者招待会。

items.meaning: to carry across to another place
items.example: Please transfer the call to my office.
items.exampleCN: 请把电话转接到我的办公室。

definition_zh: 承认；坦白；供认；忏悔
definition_en: to admit that you have done something wrong
core_image: 一个人低着头，把藏在心里很久的事说出来
scene: 审讯室里，他终于承认自己拿了那笔钱。He finally confessed that he had taken the money.
sceneCN: 这里 confess 指「承认」（第 1 个义项：说出自己做过的错事）；句意是他终于承认自己拿了那笔钱。

senses.title: Admit a personal fault
senses.definition: to admit to other people that you did something wrong
senses.definitionCN: 向别人承认自己做了错事
senses.example: She confessed that she had lost the key.
senses.exampleCN: 她承认自己把钥匙弄丢了。
senses.why: A fault kept inside grows, and saying it out loud lets it shrink.
senses.whyCN: 藏着的过错会变大，说出口反而让它缩小。

senses.title: Admit a crime to police
senses.definition: to tell the police or a court that you committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 向警方或法庭说明自己犯了罪
senses.example: The man confessed to the robbery.
senses.exampleCN: 那名男子供认了抢劫行为。
senses.why: The law needs a clear statement before a case can be closed.
senses.whyCN: 案件要了结，法律需要一份清楚的陈述。

senses.title: Tell one's sins in church
senses.definition: to tell a priest about your sins and ask for forgiveness
senses.definitionCN: 向神父说出自己的罪并请求宽恕
senses.example: He went to church to confess his sins.
senses.exampleCN: 他去教堂忏悔自己的罪。
senses.why: The oldest sense is religious: a burden is handed over to a higher power.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义与宗教有关：把重担交给更高的力量。

intro.en: Confess comes from Latin confiteri, to admit fully, built from com-, completely, and fateri, to acknowledge.
intro.cn: confess 来自拉丁语 confiteri，意为彻底承认，由 com-（完全）与 fateri（承认）构成。

items.en: Fateri meant to admit or declare something openly.
items.cn: fateri 意为公开承认或声明某事。

items.en: Confiteri strengthened the act into a full and open admission.
items.cn: confiteri 把这一行为加强为彻底而公开的承认。

items.en: Old French confesser used the word mainly for religious confession.
items.cn: 古法语 confesser 主要把这个词用于宗教告解。

items.en: English confess first meant to declare one's sins to a priest.
items.cn: 英语 confess 最初指向神父告明自己的罪。

items.en: It now also covers admitting a fault or a crime in everyday life.
items.cn: 如今它也覆盖日常生活中承认错误或罪行。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that share the ending of confess, and the meaning group names other ways of admitting something.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 confess 词形相近的词，近义组列出其他表示承认的说法。

entries.definition: to state a belief or feeling openly
to make someone unable to think clearly
to face a problem or person directly
to agree that something is true
to accept that a fact is real
to make something hidden known

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a secret held too long, then move to a police room and to a quiet church.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从藏得太久的秘密开始，再走到警局房间与安静的教堂。

normal.en: Con- is fully and fess- is admit, so to confess is to admit fully.
normal.cn: con- 是完全，fess- 是承认，所以 confess 就是彻底承认。

normal.en: A confession is a door that only opens from the inside.
normal.cn: 坦白是一扇只能从里面打开的门。

normal.en: Confess and confession share the same body, one is the act and one is the words.
normal.cn: confess 与 confession 同根，一个是动作，一个是说出口的话。

normal.en: In church, confession is spoken in a whisper; in court, in a clear voice.
normal.cn: 在教堂里，忏悔是低声说的；在法庭上，供认是清楚说的。

normal.en: The moment you confess, the secret stops being heavy.
normal.cn: 你说出真相的那一刻，秘密就不再沉重。

abstract.en: Picture a hand opening a clenched fist.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手慢慢松开紧握的拳头。

abstract.en: Picture a small dark room with one narrow window.
abstract.cn: 想象一间只有一扇窄窗的小黑屋。

abstract.en: Picture a stone lifted off a covered well.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石头从井口上被搬开。

examples.en: He confessed that he had broken the window.
examples.cn: 他承认自己打破了窗户。

examples.en: She refused to confess to a crime she did not commit.
examples.cn: 她拒绝供认自己没有犯过的罪。

examples.en: The old man went to confess before the holiday.
examples.cn: 节日前那位老人去做了忏悔。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 confess 记成 con（完全）加 fess（说）：把藏在心里的事完全说出来，就是承认与忏悔。

root: 源自拉丁语 confiteri（com 完全 + fateri 承认），本义是完全承认，后引申为坦白、供认与宗教忏悔。

sensesIntro.en: From a personal fault spoken aloud, to a crime admitted to police, and finally to sins told in church.
sensesIntro.cn: 从说出口的个人过失，到向警方供认的罪行，最后到在教堂告明的罪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand that has held a secret for years finally opens.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只握了许多年秘密的手终于松开。

branches.en: Everyday confession is about a small fault and a relieved mind.
branches.cn: 日常的承认关乎一个小过失与一颗放松下来的心。

branches.en: Legal confession turns private knowledge into public record.
branches.cn: 法律上的供认把私下的知情变成公开记录。

branches.en: Religious confession hands the weight to a higher power.
branches.cn: 宗教忏悔把重担交给更高的力量。

branches.en: Both ask for forgiveness, one from a person and one from heaven.
branches.cn: 两者都请求宽恕，一个向人，一个向上天。

branches.en: A court confession is only the everyday act with the law listening.
branches.cn: 法庭上的供认，不过是日常承认多了法律在听。

intro.en: Confess is built on Latin com-, fully, plus fateri, to admit.
intro.cn: confess 由拉丁语 com-（完全）与 fateri（承认）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin admit base fess- also appears in profession and profess.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的承认词基 fess- 也出现在 profession 与 profess 中。

items.example: He sat confessing to the officer.
The letter had a confessional tone.
items.exampleCN: 这封信带着忏悔的语气。

items.example: They profess great interest in the plan.
items.exampleCN: 他们声称对这个计划很有兴趣。

definition_zh: n. 知心女友，闺蜜；（戏剧中的）心腹角色
definition_en: a woman to whom one tells private things
core_image: 灯下两个人低声说话，一个只听不说
scene: 她把最难开口的心事只告诉了多年的闺蜜。She told only her old confidante the secret she could hardly speak of.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：confidante 指知心女友；句意是她只把最难说的心事告诉了多年的闺蜜。

senses.title: A trusted woman friend
senses.definition: a woman to whom one tells private things
senses.definitionCN: 可以倾诉私事的女性朋友
senses.example: Her sister was her closest confidante.
senses.exampleCN: 她姐姐是她最亲密的知己。
senses.why: The final -e marks the feminine form.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -e 标示女性形式。

senses.title: A listening role on stage
senses.definition: a character who hears the hero private thoughts
senses.definitionCN: 倾听主角心事的剧中人物
senses.example: The confidante listens and says little.
senses.exampleCN: 心腹角色只听少说。
senses.why: The stage borrowed the word for a listening role.
senses.whyCN: 戏剧借这个词指倾听的角色。

intro.en: Confidante is the feminine of confidant, from Latin confidere, to trust fully.
intro.cn: confidante 是 confidant 的阴性形式，源自拉丁语 confidere（完全信任）。

items.en: Fidere means to trust.
items.cn: fidere 意为信任。

items.en: Confidere means to trust fully.
items.cn: confidere 意为完全信任。

items.en: Confier means to entrust.
items.cn: confier 意为托付。

items.en: French marked the feminine with -e.
items.cn: 十七世纪法语用 -e 标阴性。

items.en: English kept both confidant and confidante.
items.cn: 十八世纪英语并留阴阳两形。

note.en: The look-alike group differs only by ending; the near-meaning group names close friends.
note.cn: 形近组只差词尾；近义组列出亲近之人。

entries.definition: A man trusted with secrets.
To tell a secret in trust.
Trust or self-assurance.
A person one likes and trusts.
A person who gives advice.
A person who spends time with another.

normalIntro.en: A confidante is the ear that keeps a secret.
normalIntro.cn: confidante 是那只替人保守秘密的耳朵。

normal.en: Confidere means to trust fully.
normal.cn: confidere 意为完全信任。

normal.en: A confidant is trusted with secrets.
normal.cn: confidant 受托秘密。

normal.en: The -e makes the friend a woman.
normal.cn: -e 让这位朋友成为女性。

normal.en: On stage she hears the hero out.
normal.cn: 舞台上她听完主角的心事。

normal.en: She listens more than she speaks.
normal.cn: 她听得多，说得少。

abstract.en: A lamp and two lowered voices.
abstract.cn: 一盏灯和两个压低的声音。

abstract.en: A door closed on a shared secret.
abstract.cn: 关住共同秘密的一扇门。

abstract.en: An ear that never repeats.
abstract.cn: 一只从不复述的耳朵。

examples.en: She was his only confidante.
examples.cn: 她是他唯一的知己。

examples.en: A confidante keeps what she hears.
examples.cn: 知己会守住听到的话。

examples.en: The queen spoke to her confidante at night.
examples.cn: 王后在夜里向知己倾诉。

dict_mnemonic.text: confide（倾诉）+ -ante（阴性后缀）→ 可以倾诉秘密的女性。

root: 拉丁 confidere（完全信任）→ 法语 confidente → 英语 confidante

sensesIntro.en: The woman trusted with what cannot be said aloud.
sensesIntro.cn: 受托保管那些不能高声说出之事的那位女性。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two heads close under a single lamp
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏灯下凑近的两个头

branches.en: A sister who never tells.
branches.cn: 从不外传的姐姐。

branches.en: A friend called at midnight.
branches.cn: 半夜被拨通的友人。

branches.en: A quiet figure at the edge of the stage.
branches.cn: 舞台边安静的一个人物。

branches.en: A listener who asks nothing.
branches.cn: 什么也不追问的倾听者。

branches.en: A trusted ear, real or written.
branches.cn: 可信的耳朵，真实或虚构。

intro.en: Confidante joins the trust root fid to a feminine ending.
intro.cn: confidante 把表「信任」的词根 fid 接上阴性词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin fidere is to trust; confidere is to trust fully.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fidere 意为信任，confidere 意为完全信任。

definition_zh: v. 倾诉，吐露（秘密）；委托，信赖

core.cn: 核心意象：封好的信封、上锁的抽屉，以及两个低声说话的人。

branches.en: The document sense is the most common and the most formal.
branches.cn: 文件义项最常见，也最正式。

branches.en: The manner sense shows trust through the way words are said.
branches.cn: 态度义项通过说话的方式表现出信任。

branches.en: Both senses assume that only a few people are allowed in.
branches.cn: 两个义项都假定只有少数人被允许进入。

branches.en: A confidential paper is protected by rules, not by luck.
branches.cn: 机密文件靠制度保护，而不是靠运气。

branches.en: A confidential tone is the sound of a circle closing.
branches.cn: 表示信任的语气，是一个圈子收拢时发出的声音。

intro.en: Confidential is confidentia, trust, plus the adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: confidential 由 confidentia（信任）与形容词词尾 -al 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin trust base fid- also appears in fidelity and confident.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的信任词基 fid- 也出现在 fidelity 与 confident 中。

in a secret or private way
the duty of keeping information secret

items.example: She is confident of a good result.

items.meaning: to tell a secret in trust

Only her confidant knew the plan.

definition_zh: 配置；布局；构型；排列方式
definition_en: the way parts are arranged or set up, especially in a computer system or a physical structure
core_image: 按图纸把零件摆成一张互相连接的网
scene: 这组词中，In the server room, the engineer changed the configuration so that storage and network traffic no longer shared the same channel.
sceneCN: 这里 configuration 是「配置」（第 3 个义项：系统设置）；句意：机房里，工程师修改配置，使存储流量和网络流量不再共用同一通道。图中可辨识物件：机柜、服务器、网线、设置界面、标签。

pos.zh: 配置；布局；构型；排列方式

derivatives.zh: 已配置的；按特定方式设置的

senses.title: Arrangement of parts: layout
senses.titleCN: 排列方式/布局：部件如何摆
senses.definition: the way in which parts of something are arranged in relation to one another
senses.definitionCN: 某事物的各个部分相对于彼此摆放的方式
senses.example: The spatial configuration of the rooms makes the building easy to navigate.
senses.exampleCN: 房间的空间布局让这栋建筑很容易通行。
senses.why: configurare means 'to shape together', and -ation names the result of that shaping. A configuration is therefore the arrangement that results when parts are placed together.
senses.whyCN: configurare 意为“一起塑形”，-ation 命名塑形的结果。因此 configuration 就是把部件放在一起后形成的排列。

senses.title: Computer configuration
senses.titleCN: 计算机配置：硬件与软件的搭配
senses.definition: the combination of hardware and software settings that make up a computer setup
senses.definitionCN: 构成一台计算机系统的硬件与软件设置的组合
senses.example: This laptop's configuration includes 32 GB of memory and a 1 TB drive.
senses.exampleCN: 这台笔记本电脑的配置包括 32 GB 内存和 1 TB 硬盘。
senses.why: The same result noun is applied to a machine: the parts and settings are 'shaped together' into one working setup, and -ation names that finished arrangement.
senses.whyCN: 同一个结果名词被用到机器上：部件与设置被“一起塑形”成一套可工作的系统，-ation 命名的正是这个完成的排列。

senses.title: System configuration
senses.titleCN: 系统配置：决定运行方式的设置组合
senses.definition: the set of settings that determines how a system behaves
senses.definitionCN: 决定一个系统如何运行的一组设置
senses.example: Changing the system configuration can affect how services start.
senses.exampleCN: 更改系统配置可能影响服务的启动方式。
senses.why: -ation here names an abstract arrangement rather than visible parts: settings are placed in relation to one another, and that arrangement controls behaviour.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 -ation 命名抽象排列而非可见部件：各项设置被摆放到彼此的关系中，而这个排列控制系统行为。

senses.title: Configuration file
senses.titleCN: 配置文件：存放设置的载体
senses.definition: a file that stores the settings of a program or system, often shortened to 'configuration' in IT speech
senses.definitionCN: 存放程序或系统设置的文件，在信息技术口语中常简称为 configuration
senses.example: Back up the configuration before you upgrade the router.
senses.exampleCN: 升级路由器之前先备份配置文件。
senses.why: This is metonymy: the file holds the configuration, so speakers name the container by its contents. The -ation noun itself still means the arrangement.
senses.whyCN: 这是转喻：文件承载配置，于是说话者用内容来称呼容器。-ation 名词本身仍然表示“排列”。

senses.title: Spatial configuration
senses.titleCN: 空间构型：几何上的摆放关系
senses.definition: the geometric arrangement of points, lines, or objects in space
senses.definitionCN: 点、线或物体在空间中的几何排列
senses.example: The configuration of the three towers forms a triangle around the plaza.
senses.exampleCN: 三座塔楼的构型在广场周围形成一个三角形。
senses.why: Here figura is literal: the noun names the shape produced by placing objects at certain positions, with -ation marking the resulting form.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 figura 是字面意义：名词命名的是把物体放在特定位置后产生的形状，-ation 标记结果形态。

senses.title: Molecular configuration
senses.titleCN: 分子构型：原子在空间中的排布
senses.definition: the arrangement of atoms in a molecule in three-dimensional space
senses.definitionCN: 分子中原子在三维空间中的排列方式
senses.example: The two isomers differ only in their molecular configuration.
senses.exampleCN: 这两种异构体仅在分子构型上不同。
senses.why: Chemistry borrows the noun for atoms 'shaped together'. The -ation result noun fits exactly: spatial placement of parts determines the molecule's identity.
senses.whyCN: 化学借用这个名词来描述原子被“一起塑形”。-ation 结果名词完全契合：部件在空间中的摆放决定分子的身份。

senses.title: Configuration management
senses.titleCN: 配置管理：让排列保持可控
senses.definition: the practice of recording, controlling, and tracking the settings of a system over time
senses.definitionCN: 对系统设置进行记录、控制和长期追踪的实践
senses.example: Configuration management keeps every server's settings under version control.
senses.exampleCN: 配置管理把每台服务器的设置都纳入版本控制。
senses.why: The noun becomes an object of management. -ation names a stable arrangement that can be recorded and changed deliberately, so it can be governed.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词成为管理的对象。-ation 命名一种可被记录、可被有意更改的稳定排列，因此可以被治理。

senses.title: Default configuration
senses.titleCN: 默认配置：初始的那套设置
senses.definition: the arrangement of settings that a product uses before the user changes anything
senses.definitionCN: 用户做出任何更改之前产品所使用的那套设置
senses.example: The app runs on its default configuration until you change it.
senses.exampleCN: 在你更改之前，这个应用一直运行在默认配置下。
senses.why: Default marks the arrangement set at the factory. The -ation noun is the same result noun, only fixed before the user begins to rearrange it.
senses.whyCN: default 标记出厂时设定的排列。这里的 -ation 仍是同一个结果名词，只是它在用户开始重新排列之前就已被固定。

senses.title: Network configuration
senses.titleCN: 网络配置：节点与地址的安排
senses.definition: the arrangement of devices, addresses, and connections in a network
senses.definitionCN: 网络中设备、地址和连接的安排方式
senses.example: A wrong network configuration left the printer offline.
senses.exampleCN: 错误的网络配置让打印机离线。
senses.why: The arrangement is now between devices rather than inside one machine, but -ation still names the way the parts are set in relation to one another.
senses.whyCN: 此时的排列发生在设备之间，而不是单台机器内部，但 -ation 仍然命名各部分彼此摆放的方式。

intro.en: Configuration is a three-stage derivative: Latin figura gives the idea of shape, configurare adds 'together', and -ation turns the verb into a noun. English technical uses are much later than the Latin base, and exact dates are approximate.
intro.cn: configuration 是分三步构成的派生词：拉丁 figura 提供“形状”观念，configurare 加上“一起”，-ation 再把动词变成名词。英语技术用法远晚于拉丁词基，确切年代为大致估计。

items.en: figura meant 'shape, form, figure'. The word begins with something visible that has an outline, not with an abstract plan.
items.cn: figura 意为“形状、外形、图形”。这个词的起点是一个有轮廓的可见之物，而不是抽象计划。

items.en: figurare meant 'to shape, form'. It turns the noun of shape into the act of giving shape.
items.cn: figurare 意为“使成形、塑造”。它把“形状”名词变成“赋予形状”的动作。

items.en: configurare adds con- 'together': to shape several things together, that is, to arrange them in relation to one another.
items.cn: configurare 加上 con-“一起”：把若干事物一起塑形，也就是按彼此的关系来安排它们。

items.en: English configure appears in the 17c. with the sense 'to form or arrange'. The verb is the base to which the noun suffix will attach.
items.cn: 英语 configure 在 17 世纪出现，意为“形成、安排”。这个动词就是名词后缀将要附着的词基。

items.en: configure + -ation, from Latin -atio(nem), forms a noun of process or result. Configuration is either the act of arranging or the arrangement that results.
items.cn: configure + -ation（来自拉丁 -atio(nem)）构成过程或结果名词。configuration 既可指安排的动作，也可指安排后的结果。

items.en: In 20c. computing the noun shifted toward stored settings: configuration file, system configuration, default configuration. Chemistry and IT management added molecular configuration and configuration management; exact first uses vary.
items.cn: 在 20 世纪的计算机领域，这个名词转向存储的设置：configuration file、system configuration、default configuration。化学和信息技术管理又加入 molecular configuration 与 configuration management；确切首次用法各异。

note.en: The look-alikes are other members of the configure family. The near-meaning words all describe how parts are placed, but each highlights a different aspect.
note.cn: 形近词是 configure 词族的其他成员。近义词都描述部件如何摆放，但各自突出不同侧面。

entries.definition: To set up or arrange parts for a particular purpose. It is the verb from which configuration is derived.
entries.definitionCN: 为特定目的设置或安排部件。它是 configuration 的派生来源动词。

entries.definition: Able to be configured or changed in arrangement. The -able suffix marks capacity, not the arrangement itself.
entries.definitionCN: 可配置的；排列可更改的。-able 后缀标记能力，而不是排列本身。

entries.definition: A tool or person that configures something, such as an online product configurator.
entries.definitionCN: 配置工具或配置者，如在线产品配置器。

entries.definition: The general way things are put in order or position. It is broader and less technical than configuration.
entries.definitionCN: 事物被排列或放置的一般方式。它比 configuration 更宽泛，技术性更弱。

entries.definition: The way a system or device is organized, or the act of preparing it. It is informal and common in everyday computing.
entries.definitionCN: 系统或设备的组织方式，或准备它的动作。它偏口语，常用于日常计算机语境。

entries.definition: The arrangement of physical elements on a page or in a space. It stresses visible placement.
entries.definitionCN: 物理元素在页面或空间中的布置。它强调可见的位置安排。

entries.definition: The way parts combine to form a whole. It stresses the mixture of components more than their precise placement.
entries.definitionCN: 各部分组合成整体的方式。它更强调成分的混合，而不是精确位置。

entries.definition: The three-dimensional shape adopted by a molecule. It is close to molecular configuration but often implies a shape that can change.
entries.definitionCN: 分子所采取的三维形状。它与 molecular configuration 接近，但常暗示形状可以改变。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin root figura, the real suffix chain, and the real computing phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词根 figura、真实的后缀链，以及真实的计算机搭配。

normal.en: con- 'together' + figura 'shape' + -ation: the noun is literally 'a shaping together'.
normal.cn: con-“一起”+ figura“形状”+ -ation：这个名词字面上就是“一起塑形”。

normal.en: A configuration file is the place where the arrangement is written down.
normal.cn: configuration file 就是把这个排列写下来的地方。

normal.en: Default configuration is the arrangement you get before you move anything.
normal.cn: default configuration 是你动手改动之前拿到的排列。

normal.en: Molecular configuration is the same idea at atomic scale: atoms placed in relation to one another.
normal.cn: molecular configuration 是同一观念在原子尺度上的版本：原子相对彼此摆放。

normal.en: Configuration management treats the arrangement as something that can be versioned and restored.
normal.cn: configuration management 把这种排列当作可以版本化、可以恢复的对象。

abstract.en: Think of LEGO bricks laid out according to a manual: the same bricks can make different objects depending on their configuration.
abstract.cn: 想象按说明书摆开的乐高积木：同样的积木因配置不同可以拼成不同物体。

abstract.en: Think of pins on a map connected by lines: the pins are the parts, and the web of lines is the configuration.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上用线连接起来的大头针：针是部件，线织成的网就是 configuration。

abstract.en: Think of a rack of servers with cables running between them: one wrong cable changes the whole arrangement.
abstract.cn: 想象一柜服务器之间连着的线缆：接错一根线就会改变整个排列。

examples.en: The configuration of the exhibition hall was changed to create wider walkways.
examples.cn: 展厅的布局被改动，以留出更宽的通道。

examples.en: You can restore the default configuration if the new settings cause problems.
examples.cn: 如果新设置引发问题，你可以恢复默认配置。

examples.en: The two molecules share the same formula but differ in configuration.
examples.cn: 这两个分子化学式相同，但构型不同。

dict_mnemonic.text: “肯菲格蕾神”——肯（con）菲（fi）格（gu）蕾（ra）神（tion）按格子把零件摆好 → configuration 配置、布局

root: 拉丁 configurare“按形状摆好”（con-“一起”+ figurare“使成形”，figura“形状、外形”）；configure + -ation“过程或结果名词”。

sensesIntro.en: All nine senses are one noun seen from different angles: parts are shaped together, and the resulting arrangement can be physical, digital, or molecular.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都是同一个名词的不同观察角度：部件被一起塑形，而所得的排列可以是物理的、数字的或分子的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: parts placed together according to a plan until they form one connected shape.
core.cn: 核心意象：部件按图纸摆在一起，直到形成一个互相连接的整体形状。

branches.en: VISIBLE ARRANGEMENT: rooms, towers, and points form a layout or a geometric shape.
branches.cn: 可见排列：房间、塔楼和点构成布局或几何形状。

branches.en: MACHINE SETUP: hardware and software are arranged into a working setup, with a default state before changes.
branches.cn: 机器设置：硬件与软件被安排成可工作的组合，改动前有默认状态。

branches.en: SYSTEM AND NETWORK: settings or devices are placed in relation to one another and control how traffic flows.
branches.cn: 系统与网络：设置或设备彼此摆放，并控制流量如何流动。

branches.en: STORAGE: the arrangement is written into a file, and the container is named by its contents.
branches.cn: 存储：排列被写入文件，容器以内容命名。

branches.en: SCIENCE AND MANAGEMENT: atoms take a molecular shape, and the whole arrangement can be tracked and governed.
branches.cn: 科学与管理：原子形成分子形状，而整个排列可以被追踪和治理。

intro.en: Configuration is configure + -ation. -ation is the productive noun suffix of process or result; con- and figura are inherited inside the base and are not separately felt by most speakers.
intro.cn: configuration 是 configure + -ation。-ation 是表示过程或结果的能产名词后缀；con- 与 figura 已凝固在词基内部，多数说话者不会把它们单独拆开感受。

latinIntro.en: Latin figura 'shape' also gives figure, figurative, and figment; the verb figurare underlies configuration, transfiguration and disfigure. The family is about giving or changing form.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 figura“形状”还衍生出 figure、figurative、figment；动词 figurare 是 configuration、transfiguration、disfigure 的基础。这个词族的核心是赋予或改变形式。

items.meaning: an arrangement of parts or settings
items.meaningCN: 配置；布局；构型（-ation 构成过程或结果名词）
items.example: The standard configuration suits most small offices.
items.exampleCN: 标准配置适合大多数小型办公室。

items.meaning: to arrange or set up parts
items.meaningCN: 配置；安排；设定（con-“一起”+ figurare“塑形”）
items.example: Configure the router before connecting it to the network.
items.exampleCN: 先把路由器配置好，再接入网络。

items.meaning: set up in a particular way
items.meaningCN: 已配置的；按特定方式设置的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: The laptop is configured for video editing.
items.exampleCN: 这台笔记本电脑已按视频剪辑的需求配置好。

items.meaning: able to be arranged or changed
items.meaningCN: 可配置的（-able 表示“能够被……”）
items.example: The keyboard shortcuts are fully configurable.
items.exampleCN: 键盘快捷键完全可配置。

items.meaning: a tool or person that configures
items.meaningCN: 配置器；配置者（-ator 表示施动者或工具）
items.example: The online configurator lets buyers choose every part.
items.exampleCN: 在线配置器让买家选择每一个部件。

items.meaning: a new arrangement after a change
items.example: A reconfiguration of the network solved the bottleneck.
items.exampleCN: 网络的重新配置解决了瓶颈问题。

items.example: The devices are preconfigured before they leave the factory.
items.exampleCN: 这些设备在出厂前已预配置好。

items.example: A misconfiguration exposed the database to the internet.
items.exampleCN: 一处错误配置让数据库暴露在互联网上。

items.meaning: a shape, a diagram, or a number
items.meaningCN: 形状；图形；数字（直接来自 figura）
items.example: The figure on the screen shows how the parts fit together.
items.exampleCN: 屏幕上的图形展示了各部件如何组合。
